title: On Reforming the school in three years
subtitle: 社区社会 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）
meta: 主题语境：社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）　|　核心词汇：reform　|　正文 352 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 reform 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1993 the trader ① reformed the school in three years on the same day, and every partner in the market said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the trader ② reforms the school in three years before dawn without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ reform the school in three years at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ reformed the school in three years before — a line in the list for October 1987 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Reforming the school in three years on the same day, the trader said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the basket at the far stall, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ reform the worst of the old rules before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Reform the worst of the old rules at once and never mention it again.

By 2000 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the list, and a new partner from the next market ⑧ reforms the worst of the old rules on the same day every week without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the stall, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ reformed the school in three years again when nobody else would.

⑩ To reform the school in three years, my mother said in 2005, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the market remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the market forgets, somebody reforms the school in three years before dawn again and somebody must reform the school in three years on the same day all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 改革（一般过去式 reformed the school in three years：1993 年货商头一回这样做，当天就）
B. v. 改革（一般现在 reforms the school in three years：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 改革（不定式 to reform the school in three years：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 改革（过去完成时 had reformed the school in three years：1987 年十月的货单上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 改革（动名词 reforming the school in three years 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 改造（reform the worst of the old rules：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去改造把旧规矩里最坏的那几条改掉）
G. v. 改造（reform the worst of the old rules：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 改革（后段两处：新来的伙计照例 reforms the worst of the old rules，而母亲又一次 reformed the school in three years）

answers.why: reform 意为“改革”，1993 年货商当天就改革三年里把那所学堂改了样子，那是集市里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 reformed。
reform 意为“改革”，自那以后货商天没亮就把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 reforms。
reform 意为“改革”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯改革三年里把那所学堂改了样子”，此处为不定式 to reform the school in three years。
reform 意为“改革”，货单里 十月 那行字说明早在 2000 年之前就有人改革过，故用过去完成时 had reformed。
reform 意为“改革”，货商说“改革三年里把那所学堂改了样子这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 reforming the school in three years 作主语。
reform 意为“改造”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去改造把旧规矩里最坏的那几条改掉”，should ever 之后用原形 reform the worst of the old rules。
reform 意为“改造”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻改造把旧规矩里最坏的那几条改掉（reform the worst of the old rules at once），以后再也不要提起。
reform 意为“改革”，新来的伙计每个星期都照例改造把旧规矩里最坏的那几条改掉，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 reforms。
reform 意为“改革”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次当天就改革三年里把那所学堂改了样子，用一般过去式 reformed 叙述。
reform 意为“改革”，结尾那句是母亲 2005 年的话：要改革三年里把那所学堂改了样子，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和集市记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 reform 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1993 the trader reformed the school in three years on the same day, and nobody in the market forgot it.
Even now the trader reforms the school in three years before dawn whenever the market asks.
Reforming the school in three years on the same day, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever reform the worst of the old rules before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new partner from the next market reforms the worst of the old rules on the same day every week, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother reformed the school in three years again, and the market remembered that half.
